Subject: Fraudulent withdrawals from the Accounts of EPFO through fake cheques-
instructions to avoid fraudulent payment- reg.

Sir,

Instructions were issued vide this office circular No. Bkg/Fraud/05/18210 dated 22/11/2011, posted
at SI. No. 405. of the official website of the organization under Office Orders & Circulars for the year 2011-12
to avoid fraudulent withdrawals.

2 References are received from various field offices pointing out that implementation of the instructions
contained in the circular referred in para 1 above will lead to return of claims already received in the office
wherein the benefits payable are more than Rs. 10,000/-. This will lead to undue hardship to the PF
beneficiaries.

3: The issue has been examined at Head Office and the restriction on issuing of cheques for amount
beyond Rs. 10,000/- from Account Nos. 1,10 and 21 is modified as under :

i) Account No. 01 : Upto Rs. 1,00,000/-
ii) Account No. 10 : Upto Rs. 50,000/-
iii) | Account No.21  : Upto Rs. 1,30,000/-

The limit of Rs. 10,000/- wherever appears in the circular dated 22.11.2011 referred in para 1 above
stands modified accordingly. The revised limits shall be effective from 1% December,2011.

4. The cheques can be issued from Account Nos. 1,10 and 21 upto the limits mentioned above only in
cases where the payments are not possible through NEFT.

5} This may be brought to the notice of the Establishments covered under the EPF&MP Act,1952 through
Press release at local level.

( This issues with the approval of CPFC ).
